desc: White downspout connected to a black underground drain adapter beside a Florida stucco home, with a short controlled excavation, solid drain pipe, green cleanout cap, sandy soil, and a plain shovel staged nearby.
reuse_notes: Use for underground downspout drains, drain extensions, stormwater routing, cleanouts, site drainage, and related repair-scope articles. It depicts a generic controlled installation scene, never a JK Prestige project or proof that a particular discharge location complies with every local requirement.
